Marcus, Monica —

If Acme is in SGT, let's send a separate invite that pins the zone explicitly. I've seen Outlook/Gmail display times differently when invites are created in PT without timezone tag. Quick checklist: 
- Create a new .ics with DTSTART/DTEND in TZID=Asia/Singapore
- Put the agenda in the invite body (Sarah requested)
- Add "Region: APAC (SGT)" to the title so it's obvious in calendar UI

Draft text to send to customer below — feel free to edit before sending:
> Hi Sarah — thanks for confirming. Attached is a new invite set to 14:00 SGT on Tue 16 Mar (please accept if that shows correctly). Agenda: 1) Prod overview 2) Integration considerations 3) Next steps. See you then!

If Marcus prefers, I can create the invite and drop it in your calendar (Marcus). Also recommending we log this as a scheduling note on the HubSpot deal so AE knows region preference.
